description:
Market Health history: the composite risk-score snapshots for the last 30
days (hourly, with flips7d = label changes in the last 7 days), a ~30-session
derived line series per detector (percent vs moving average, ratios vs their
MAs, N-day percent changes and spreads — never raw prices), and signalChanges:
which scored detectors changed status since the previous trading day's last
snapshot. Every line carries a unit string. The junk-credit-spread detector has
no lines (its source series is third-party licensed) and economic-calendar events
are not included. Self-caching (15 min). No parameters.
name: get_market_health_history
